class_guess: Counter Class 4: recursive run-length counter (self-similar epochs, time doubles per epoch)
summary: Run-length counter: epochs double in time, 2 passenger marker 1s; 9 rules validated, inner invariant open
mechanism: Tape = runs of 1s. R1: pointer A moves one run right; a 1 moves from its old run to the run past the 00 gap.
R2: A on a lone 1 merges it left and jumps 2 runs back; R3 grows the left edge. Halt needs 0^inf 1 <A: never seen.
Epochs: short (40k+288 steps), then long (~1260*2^k): run 1 counts 2k+1 -> 1, each tick a doubling mini-epoch.

rules.name: R1 pointer right
rules.cases: n,m,x>=0; x=0 covers 0^3 and 0^inf after the 00

rules.name: HALT
rules.cases: only halting route; needs a lone 1 at the far left

rules.name: long epoch
rules.to: Fs(k+1,P') with P' even, 2<=P'<=2k; or D(k+1)
rules.cases: P' irregular in (k,P), e.g. k=11: P 2,4,6,8,10,12 -> 6,8,10,16,D,4. Macro model: every even P for k<=13 closes with no halt

rules.name: E back to family
rules.cases: k=3..10; the real orbit takes D at k=25 (step 4.2e10), then E, then Fs(26,2)

template.diff: 10/12 transitions differ (best renaming+mirror); CounterClass3v2 8/12, closest CounterClass1 machine 8/12
template.note: No rules or shapes carry over: 7 of 16 CC2v1 starting shapes (SkelE/Be) halt on this machine. What does carry over is the proof skeleton: an Inductive Side type, a Good invariant and progress_nonhalt_cond.

strategy: Level 1: prove R1/R2/R2e/R3 with es plus shift rules (C> 1^n, D>, <F sweeps) and induction on run lengths. Level 2: copy the CounterClass2v1 pattern, with epoch starts Fs/Fl/D/E as an Inductive state with P existential, a Good invariant and progress_nonhalt_cond. Open: an invariant for the long epoch's right side that does not depend on P.
risks: The inner invariant for the long epoch is not found yet. The right side is a recursive mini-counter, likely CC2v1-sized (~100 KB).
The P->P' marker map is irregular, so the proof must work for every even P, plus the degenerate D branch.
Untouched class with no Counter Class 4 precedent. The twin (6 transitions away) needs its own instance.
